target.name: Heat, at 30 m2 Cu collector, multiple dwelling, flat roof, for hot water

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 3.2 'Unit process raw data of the supply of useful heat from solar thermal systems without considering auxiliary heating', 5th value column ('solar system, 30 m2 Cu flat plate collector, on flat roof, hot water') [CH], per 1 MJ; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: The dataset is explicitly 'without considering auxiliary heating', so no back-up boiler or electric heater appears.
The collector, storage tank, pump, piping and their disposal are all inside the linked 'solar system ...' infrastructure dataset (Tab. 2.9), not repeated here.
No water or antifreeze make-up for the collector loop.

The BAFU name says 'multiple dwelling' while the report labels this column only 'on flat roof'; the 81 m2 column is the one the report calls 'multiple dwelling', so the column choice rests on the 30 m2 / flat roof match.
skipped_items: transport, van <3.5t: no dataset chosen (No freight service for a van under 3.5 t is offered: candidate 0 is its disposal, candidate 1 a passenger ship in person-kilometres and candidate 2 the van's operation in vehicle-kilometres. None of them is a ton-kilometre freight service, so the line is reported as missing.)
